biotools.summary: BrainBuilder is a software pipeline for reconstructing 3-dimensional cortical maps from multi-modal 2D data sets of post-mortem brain sections. It allows for mesoscale mapping of chemo- and cytoarchitecture across multiple species without requiring a reference volume.
